description_sq:
Ne zemren e Tiranes, perballe Ambasades Amerikane, nje nga kullat me ikonike te qytetit, Ambassy Tower, ofrohet apartament 1+1 qe perfaqeson standardin me te larte te jeteses urbane.
Objekti eshte konceptuar si nje destinacion i plote jetese, duke integruar ambiente banimi, dyqane, zyra, showroom, palester dhe facilitete moderne qe ofrojne komoditet, sigurie dhe elegance ne cdo detaj.
Pozicionimi prane Stadiumit Air Albania, Parkut te Madh dhe qendres se Tiranes e ben kete prone unike, ideale si per banim ashtu edhe per investim afatgjate.
Apartamenti ka nje organizim funksional me:
• 69.5 m2 siperfaqe neto
• 92.87 m2 siperfaqe bruto
Arkitekture bashkekohore, standarde te larta ndertimi dhe nje vendndodhje premium e bejne kete apartament nje zgjedhje te sigurt per ata qe kerkojne cilesi, prestigj dhe vlere ne kohe.
Per me shume informacion, ju ftoj te kontaktoni ne numrin e telefonit ose prane zyres per te marre cdo detaj te nevojshem.
description_en: In the heart of Tirana, in front of the American Embassy, ​​one of the most iconic towers of the city, the Embassy Tower, a 1+1 apartment is offered that represents the highest standard of urban living. The facility is conceived as a complete lifestyle destination, integrating residential premises, shops, offices, showroom, gym and modern facilities that offer comfort, safety and elegance in every detail. Positioning near the Air Albania Stadium, the Great Park and the center of Tirana makes this property unique, ideal for both residence and long-term investment. The apartment has a functional organization with: • 69.5 m2 net area • 92.87 m2 gross area Contemporary architecture, high construction standards and a premium location make this apartment a safe choice for those looking for quality, prestige and value in time. For more information, I invite you to contact us at the phone number or at the office to get all the necessary details.
